done_when: forge ask accepts --model and --effort, falls back to [models.lite] without them, stays read-only, and runs as an ephemeral Codex conversation that is never saved to the Codex chat list; an end-to-end test through forge ask with a throwaway Codex home proves each
why: forge ask always uses the models in forge.toml's [models.lite], so the coordinator can't run a read-only audit on a stronger model or effort, and each ask leaves a chat in the owner's Codex list
